title: Health Insurance Product Guide
content:
Health Insurance Product Guide
Available Plans

title: Customers can choose an individual health plan, family floater plan, or senior-s
content: Customers can choose an individual health plan, family floater plan, or senior-support review path. Plan suitability depends on age, city, coverage amount, budget, and medical disclosures.

title: Family Coverage
content:
Family Coverage
Family floater coverage can include spouse and children under one shared coverage limit. The agent should collect each family member's age before suggesting a family floater.

title: Coverage Amount
content:
Coverage Amount
Common requested coverage ranges include 5 lakhs, 10 lakhs, and 25 lakhs. Exact premium quotes require advisor review.

title: Adding Spouse Later
content:
Adding Spouse Later
A spouse can usually be reviewed for addition at renewal or through an endorsement request, subject to policy terms and underwriting checks.

title: Claims Process
content:
Claims Process
For claims, the customer should contact the service team, share policy details, hospital or bill documents, and follow the insurer's cashless or reimbursement process.

title: Premium Objection
content:
Premium Objection
If the customer says the premium is high, explain benefits, suggest checking a lower coverage amount or simpler plan, and offer advisor review. Do not promise discounts.

title: Existing Insurance
content:
Existing Insurance
If the customer already has insurance, ask the renewal date and offer a comparison review before recommending any switch.

title: Qualification Rules
content:
Qualification Rules
- Adult applicants between 18 and 65 may be eligible depending on product.
- Incomplete applications should be escalated for callback.
- If the caller asks for unavailable policy exclusions, explain that the agent should verify with the human team.

title: Incomplete Application Handling
content:
Incomplete Application Handling
If required details are missing or conflicting, do not guess. Collect the missing fields or escalate for a human callback.

title: Insurance Renewal Policy
content:
Insurance Renewal Policy
Policy renewal notice is sent 30 days before expiry.
If premium remains unpaid after the grace period, the policy may lapse.

title: Coverage continues only when the premium is received within the allowed period.
content: Coverage continues only when the premium is received within the allowed period.

title: Escalation
content:
Escalation
If a customer disputes billing or requests a formal review, route to the service team.

title: Branch Partnership Program
content:
# Branch Partnership Program
Branch Partnership Benefits

title: Operational, marketing, and technology support is provided to branch partners.
content:
Operational, marketing, and technology support is provided to branch partners.
Partners receive onboarding guidance, co-branded campaign materials, and access to product updates.

title: Eligibility
content:
Eligibility
Eligible partners must be licensed financial institutions or approved distribution partners.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
content:
Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What support do branch partners receive?
A: Partners receive operational support, marketing support, and implementation guidance.

title: Q: Who can apply?
content:
Q: Who can apply?
A: Licensed institutions and approved distribution partners may apply.
